# Donato Tours Website Project

This is a modern, professional website for Donato Tours, a tour company specializing in Amazon rainforest and pampas tours in Bolivia.

## Project Guidelines
- Focus on responsive, mobile-first design
- Use modern CSS features (Flexbox, Grid, CSS Variables)
- Implement smooth animations and transitions
- Maintain accessibility standards
- Keep the design clean, professional, and inviting
- Emphasize the natural beauty of Bolivia's Amazon region
- Use earth tones and nature-inspired color palette
- Ensure fast loading times and optimized images

## Key Features
- Hero section with compelling imagery
- Tour packages showcase
- Photo gallery
- Contact information and booking
- Responsive navigation
- Smooth scrolling effects
- Professional typography
